Do not report vulnerabilities here. Follow [the security policy](https://github.com/magrathean-uk/xauex/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
Remove credentials, account identifiers, private host details and runtime data before posting.

## Problem

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduction

Include the component, commit, relevant environment and minimal steps. Use synthetic inputs where possible.

## Checks and evidence

List the commands you ran and their results. Add only short, redacted diagnostics. Distinguish local test results from target-host observations.
